summary.headline: Jupiter in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for planets in the houses of Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, describing effects on women, speech, learning, scandal, phlegmatic and splenic illness, and the mother. Chapter II begins the significations of Jupiter in Saturn’s house and in his own house, including honor, poverty, service to princes, riches, and the distinction between day and night.
